# Component reference

Every component, hook and utility in the kit, with its props and a working example. The same data powers the API reference on the demo's /components page.

## [Basics](./ui.md)

Buttons, badges, cards, feedback and page scaffolding.

- **Button**: The action button, in four variants and three sizes. ButtonLink renders a router link that looks the same.
- **Tag**: A small uppercase label for status or category.
- **Chip**: A pill with an optional colored initial. With `onClick` it becomes a toggle button.
- **Badge**: A bordered pill with an optional icon, for short facts such as "Read-only access".
- **Delta**: A signed percentage colored green, red or grey. Uses the locale from the theme config.
- **Dot, Eyebrow, Kbd**: Three tiny pieces: a status dot, the mono uppercase label above headings, and a keyboard key.
- **Card, CardHead, Kpi**: The raised surface, its header row, and a labelled figure for dashboards.
- **Alert**: An inline message in four tones.
- **Meter**: A thin progress bar.
- **Skeleton**: A shimmering placeholder block shown while content loads.
- **EmptyState**: A centered message for lists and tables with nothing to show.
- **Avatar, AvatarGroup**: A round (or square) user picture. Without an image it shows initials on a color derived from the name.
- **Terminal, CopyButton**: A dark code block with one row per command and a copy button.
- **Section, SectionHead, PageHero**: Page scaffolding: a bordered section in the content column, its heading block, and the large page title block.
- **Reveal**: Fades its content up when it scrolls into view.
- **AssetIcon**: A rounded letter tile in one of the chart colors, picked from the text.

## [Forms](./forms.md)

Fields, inputs, selection controls, sliders and uploads.

- **Field**: Wraps a control with its label, hint and error message, and wires the ids so screen readers read them together.
- **Input**: A single-line text box with optional icon and trailing content. TextField, PasswordField, Textarea and SearchInput build on it.
- **Select**: A keyboard-friendly dropdown with optional search and groups.
- **Checkbox, RadioGroup, Switch**: Selection controls with built-in labels and descriptions.
- **Slider**: A range input with the filled track and a live value readout.
- **OtpInput**: One box per digit for verification codes, with paste support.
- **PasswordStrength**: A four-segment strength meter with a checklist of rules. `passwordRules` and `passwordScore` are exported for your own validation.
- **Dropzone, PhotoPicker**: File upload by drag and drop or click, with thumbnails; and a round profile-photo picker.

## [Navigation](./nav.md)

Tabs, segmented control, accordion, breadcrumbs, pagination, stepper and the mega menu.

- **Tabs**: An accessible tab list. Optionally renders the active panel too.
- **Segmented**: A compact single-choice switch, such as chart ranges or list/grid.
- **Accordion**: A list of disclosure sections built on native `<details>`.
- **Breadcrumbs**: A trail of links to the current page.
- **Pagination**: Previous / next and numbered pages with ellipses (1 … 4 5 [6] 7 8 … 20).
- **Stepper**: Progress through a multi-step flow.
- **MegaMenu**: The primary navigation list with a mega panel per entry. It knows nothing about your data: entries and the side column come in as props.

## [Overlays](./overlays.md)

Popover, tooltip, menu, modal and drawer.

- **Popover**: A floating panel anchored to a trigger. It flips and shifts to stay on screen. The base for date pickers and the grid menus.
- **Tooltip**: A short label shown on hover and keyboard focus.
- **Menu**: A dropdown of actions with arrow-key navigation.
- **Modal**: A centered dialog that traps focus and locks page scroll.
- **Drawer**: A modal side sheet.

## [Data](./data.md)

The simple DataTable and the editable DataGrid for finance tables.

- **DataTable**: A simple sortable, clickable read-only table. For editing, grouping and totals use DataGrid.
- **DataGrid**: A spreadsheet-style table for finance data: search, filters, sort, collapsible groups with subtotals, column visibility, editable cells, undo, autosave, totals, CSV export and pagination.
- **GridColumn and friends**: The types you pass to DataGrid: GridColumn, GroupOption, FilterDef, CellChange, GridHistory, GridSave, GridEvent and DataGridHandle.
- **TryList**: A “Try the features” checklist whose steps tick themselves off as the visitor does them. Optional “Do it for me” buttons run a step for them.
- **Signed**: Colors its content green for positive numbers and red for negative ones.

## [Charts](./charts.md)

Area, bar, donut, candlestick, heatmap and sparkline, as plain SVG.

- **AreaChart**: A line chart with optional filled area, several series, a crosshair and a tooltip. Plain SVG, sized to its container.
- **BarChart**: Grouped bars with a legend and a hover band.
- **DonutChart**: A donut with a hover-linked legend and a center readout.
- **CandlestickChart**: OHLC candles with a volume strip and a readout.
- **Heatmap**: A calendar heatmap of daily gains (green) and losses (red).
- **Sparkline**: A tiny trend line for tables and cards. Decorative: pair it with a text value.

## [Date & time](./calendar.md)

Calendar, pickers and the event calendar.

- **Calendar**: A month grid for a single date or a date range, with month and year views. The picker components below are built on it.
- **DatePicker**: An input-style button that opens a calendar in a popover.
- **DateRangePicker**: A range picker with quick ranges (Last 7 days, Year to date …), two months on wide screens, and Apply / Cancel.
- **MonthPicker, MonthField**: A 3×4 month grid with a year header (MonthPicker), and an input-style trigger that opens it in a popover (MonthField).
- **TimeField**: A time input with hour and minute columns in a popover.
- **EventCalendar**: A full-width month grid that lists events inside each day (dots on small screens).

## [Media](./media.md)

Photo frame, gallery and lightbox.

- **Shot**: The padded, rounded, lifted frame for screenshots and photos. Reserves its space so the layout does not jump while the image loads.
- **Gallery, Lightbox**: A responsive photo grid that opens a full-screen viewer (Gallery), and the viewer itself (Lightbox).

## [Theme tools](./theme.md)

The live theme editor and its parts.

- **ThemeEditor**: The live theme editor: presets, light and dark palettes with contrast checks, gradient, chart colors, radius, widths, shadows, font, locale, currency, and JSON export, import and save.
- **ThemeDock**: A floating “Theme” button that opens the editor beside the page. A design-time tool: it only mounts on the dev server.
- **ColorField**: A native color picker plus a hex input that only commits valid colors.

## [Providers, hooks & utilities](./foundation.md)

Configuration, toasts, undo/redo, autosave, formatting and helpers.

- **ConfigProvider**: Holds the live theme and site configuration, applies it as CSS variables, and exposes it through hooks. Wrap your app in it once.
- **ToastProvider**: Transient messages in the bottom-right corner. `useToast().push(...)` shows one; it can carry a button such as Undo.
- **useHistory**: State with undo and redo. Every `set` that changes the value is one undo step (100 are kept).
- **useAutosave**: Debounced autosave with a visible status and an on/off preference remembered in this browser.
- **useEditStore**: Everything an editable table needs besides its rows: edits loaded from this browser, undo and redo, autosave, and props for DataGrid.
- **useTryList**: State for a “Try it” checklist: which steps are done, and whether the card is shown (remembered in this browser).
- **useCopy**: Copies text to the clipboard (with a fallback) and reports a temporary “copied” state.
- **useMedia**: Tracks a CSS media query.
- **usePageTitle**: Sets the document title to “Page · Site name”, or “Site name: tagline” without a title.
- **useFormat**: Number, money, percent and date formatting that follows the locale and currency in the theme config.
- **useText, useLang**: Tiny translation helper. A screen defines `{ en: {...}, tr: {...} }` and picks the dictionary that matches the site locale.
- **Utilities**: Small helpers: class names, safe storage, public asset URLs, dates and the seeded random generator.
